obligations.oracle: C2-V11 resolution fixtures plus parser negative corpus.
obligations.acceptance: Equivalent semantic inputs produce identical canonical projection; every frozen negative rejects before begin.

obligations.requirement: Only input/vector/rendering nodes activate for profile 1; dependencies and unsupported stages fail closed.
obligations.oracle: C2-PLAN activation matrix and provider/resource counters.
obligations.acceptance: Active tuples are exactly [1,2,3]; inactive stages perform zero calls/loads/allocations.

obligations.requirement: Resolved state is self-contained and deterministic across hosts and catalog removal.
obligations.acceptance: Repeated resolution, signed-zero normalization and field mutation expectations pass.

obligations.requirement: VectorPathNode maps the frozen ResolvedBrushState fields to pinned Perfect Freehand R1 exactly; legacy BrushDefinition v1 has no new-authoring mapping.
obligations.oracle: Accepted R01 corpus plus the frozen adapter mapping table in CONTRACT.md.
obligations.acceptance: Every mapped option matches the table; preview uses last=false, seal uses last=true; legacy definitions reject before begin.

obligations.requirement: New authoring seals a complete snapshot/outline and replay is catalog/evaluator independent.
obligations.oracle: C2-V12 live create, AddStroke, fresh-document replay, undo/redo and Skia observation.
obligations.acceptance: Exact stored record/projection and nonempty render observation match; no fallback branch.

obligations.acceptance: (5,2)/tag10 and payload/snapshot v2 accept; old reader rejects new carriers without mutation; mixed versions reject.

obligations.requirement: Predicted input is replaceable preview-only state.
obligations.acceptance: Prediction never changes sealed samples/outline/seed; invalid batches are atomic.

obligations.requirement: Preview latest-wins is bounded while terminal controls and commit intent are reliable.
obligations.oracle: C2-HANDOFF 64-session stall and receipt fault injection.
obligations.acceptance: No lost seal/cancel/intent; matching CanonicalVisible retires only its preview.

obligations.oracle: Intent/operation boundary tests and unknown-schema negatives.
obligations.acceptance: Brush code constructs no Operation; adapter rejects unknown schema and retries exact bytes.

obligations.requirement: Web/Android/Windows normalize/present only and share common BrushSession ownership.
obligations.oracle: Platform source checks plus accepted C0/C1 routed traces and target builds.
obligations.acceptance: No platform-local BrushRuntime/family/primitive interpretation remains in new path.

obligations.requirement: V1 documents remain decodable/renderable read-only and no new authoring reaches legacy classes.
obligations.oracle: Frozen V1 fixtures and source reachability checks.
obligations.acceptance: View/copy-original work; mutation/autosave/new stroke are rejected for legacy documents.

obligations.requirement: Existing C0/C1/input, semantic, scene, render and R01 behavior remains valid.
obligations.oracle: Existing CTest and platform contract suites.
obligations.acceptance: Required regression commands pass with only explicitly retired authoring assertions changed.

obligations.requirement: Changes stay within frozen package scope and no official Gate PASS is emitted.
obligations.oracle: Git diff scope validator and package binding checker.
obligations.acceptance: No forbidden path or dependency/lock mutation appears.
